يتمالكون (form VI)
# يَتَمَالَكُونَ (yatamālakūna) /ja.ta.maː.la.kuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَمَالَكَ (tamālaka)
# يُتَمَالَكُونَ (yutamālakūna) /ju.ta.maː.la.kuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَمَالَكَ (tamālaka)
